run.head_commit_message:
refactor(sim): the tick's rules parsed in the crate (spec 39 step 8c-ii) (#675)

* refactor(sim): the tick's rules parsed in the crate (spec 39 step 8c-ii)

lib.rs's rule parsers move into tick::rules and take slices, not Godot's
Packed arrays and VarArrays. tick::rules::of reads tick::given's
arguments into tick::Rules, so a cargo binary can give tick::step its
rules with nothing from Godot. tick_run no longer goes through VarArrays;
tick_step reads its VarArrays into the same arguments. Records the
8c-ii split in the spec.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_011AyPi1aq6JNcAPUeq58H2j

* refactor(sim): a unit made in the crate from its definition (spec 39 step 8c-iii) (#676)

8c-iii is split further (recorded in the spec): a squad spawned from its units'
definitions first needs each unit made from its definition. 8c-iii is that;
8c-iv the squad spawned from those units; the rest renumber to 8c-x.

- arms.rs (Arms::of): what a unit strikes with and wears, read from its
  definition in the crate's content as UnitArms and UnitDef read it.
- made.rs (made::unit): its sheet, words (coded in UnitWrites.all's order)
  and walker, as FormationUnits.make and TerrainWalker.of make them.
- ContentStore.made(id, faction, direction) returns them for the gdUnit test
  that holds every unit in content/units/ equal to FormationUnits.make's.
- lib.rs: a slot's words are decoded through the shared `said`.

Nothing in the tick calls them yet. Outcomes don't change.


Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_011AyPi1Lg3fd1F4qmEGsiQ6

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(sim): a squad spawned in the crate from its units (spec 39 step 8c-iv) (#677)

spawn.rs (spawn::squad) is FormationSimulation.spawn_squad in the crate,
every write the one GDScript's spawn makes:

- the units' ids and the squad's issued, its command opened on its route,
  the squad opened with its faction, direction, facing, home and width;
- each unit made by made::unit and admitted (sheet with its squad, words,
  walker, command and origin, its definition's code with its sight and
  speed), then placed at full hp, regeneration, stamina and pace;
- the squad on its route (its code given or issued), faced along it, with
  its wait, its morale at its ceiling and its combat width, and its units
  stood on their places (march::sync, placing).

The binding BodyField.spawn_squad codes the route as squad_put_route does.
tick::given's bands and walk tuning are now shared helpers. A new gdUnit
test holds the crate's whole snapshot after three spawns equal, byte for
byte, to GDScript's. Nothing in the tick calls it yet. Outcomes don't change.

* refactor(sim): a digest battle played end to end in the crate (spec 39 step 8c-vii) (#680)

8c-vii is split further: the field's actions (its builders, waves,
rehearsed rendezvous and the record's commands) are 8c-viii; the rest
renumber to 8c-xi. This part plays a battle without them.

play.rs: Play::new sets a digest battle up on its map's ground, and
Play::step is FormationSimulation.step in the crate: the tick counted,
the squads listed with every unit as CrateRoster.of(.., true) lists
them (from each unit's sheet and objects), the whole tick on the rules
built from the battle's tuning, the orders cleared, the squads listed
as the tick leaves them (Ticked::listed) and the units no squad holds
let go (UnitStore.settle). Watch holds the digest's stop rules, and
run plays to them. The binding BodyField.battle_play returns the
ticks played; the gdUnit test holds them and the crate's whole state
equal, byte for byte, to GDScript's run of the same battle. Nothing
calls it yet. Outcomes don't change.

`native/bin/breach_digest` plays formation_digest.gd's runs in the crate
with no Godot: each set's runs in the digest's order and by its labels

breach_tick_phases takes counts=1: after the times, each pass of the tick

* feat(native): snapshot tests cut from the digest's battles (spec 39 step 8d-i) (#696)

A cut is a digest battle's state after a tick (the snapshot's bytes, its
run's label and the squads listed). `cuts::resumed` reads it back into a
Play and steps the next tick, fingerprinting the field and the squads as
each lap ends; `laps::lap` now shows the squads to the watcher too.

Eight cuts from the standard digest's mirrors and clashes, chosen so that
every phase the battles act in changes the state in one, are committed
under native/rust/cuts/ (about 390 KB) and written by
`breach_digest cuts=<dir>`. Cargo tests require each to still be the
battle's state and to step as recorded. 8d is split: the field logs'
cuts, which must carry FieldPlay's state, are 8d-ii.
